description: HackSphere 3.0 — The Flagship AI/ML Hackathon by CSA! HackSphere 3.0 is CSA’s premier AI/ML hackathon, bringing together brilliant minds to innovate, build, and solve real-world problems through technology. Participants will collaborate, code, and create impactful solutions that push the boundaries of creativity and logic. This event is a part of ATMOS , BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus’s annual technical fest — one of the biggest tech festivals in India! Prize Pool: ₹70,000. Registration: Free. Registrations open till: 23th October 2026 12.00 noon. Project submissions open till: 28th October 2026. Platform: Deploy your app on catalyst platform and submit the deployed link through google form which will be mailed to you. (Detailed instructions will be mailed to you post registration ends). Contact: Dipti (8219836424), Ananya (8700721174). Turn your ideas into reality and be part of an unforgettable AI/ML innovation experience! (The hackathon will be conducted online, and the problem statement will be shared with all registered participants via email).
organiser: Birla Institute of Technology & Science (BITS) Pilani, Hyderabad Campus
